integrity.source_date_note: The principal source arXiv:2207.12596 was first submitted on 2022-07-26; the journal article was published online in 2023.
integrity.verification: The relational reduction was checked against the source's definition and frame correspondence; the Sperner bound and extremal construction were proved symbolically and replayed by exact finite computation.

scientific_limitations: The exact minimum is proved for finite irreflexive transitive frames, not arbitrary Kripke frames.
The result is a smallest-frame theorem for failure of U_n, not a general modal small-model theorem.
The originality risk is mainly uncatalogued folklore because the Sperner deduction is short once the source correspondence is known.
title: Sperner-sharp counterframe size for finite achronal-width axioms
